nodes.label: Quoted vs Derived Sourcing Discipline
nodes.rationale: Every figure is labelled quoted (linked to a vendor page or API response) or derived (arithmetic shown, inputs linked). Assumptions are stated next to the figures that rest on them, so no number can be mistaken for a vendor price.

nodes.label: In-Region Qatar Hosting Is Free
nodes.rationale: Azure Qatar Central at $31.32/mo versus AWS UAE at $29.78/mo is a $1.54 difference, so the assumed in-region premium does not exist. Moving to AWS to save money gives up the data-residency argument for nothing.

nodes.label: SMS Is the Only Steeply Scaling Cost
nodes.rationale: Past roughly 120 members, one-time passcodes cost more per month than the entire server; at 1,000 members it is eight times the server. Hosting is flat, SMS is linear, and the passcode-channel decision is worth more than every other cost choice combined.

nodes.label: Twilio Qatar SMS Pricing
nodes.rationale: $0.2634 per outbound segment to Qatari numbers, plus $1.15/mo long-code lease. Arabic bodies use UCS-2 and halve the 160-character segment budget to 70, silently doubling the bill.

nodes.label: Azure Qatar Central Hosting
nodes.rationale: Standard_B2als_v2 (2 vCPU / 4 GiB) at $31.32/mo plus a 64 GiB Standard SSD E6 at $5.76 and ~$2 backup blob, giving ~$39/mo on demand. Matches DEPLOYMENT.md §2's spec exactly.

nodes.label: AWS me-central-1 / me-south-1 Alternative
nodes.rationale: AWS operates no Qatar region; the nearest are UAE and Bahrain. Costs the same on demand and gives up the in-country argument. Reserved pricing ($18.76 vs Azure's estimated $27) is the one genuine advantage, worth about $8/month.

nodes.label: Managed Postgres Silently Breaks R7
nodes.rationale: Azure Postgres Flexible Server adds $16.06/mo minimum and destroys the redemption-immutability guarantee unless pgp_app / pgp_owner are created by hand. Paying money to break a security property is a bad trade; the container on the same VM is $0.

nodes.label: App Store Fees, $124 Year One
nodes.rationale: Google Play $25 once plus Apple $99/year. Commission is $0 because nothing is sold in-app — benefits are redeemed in person. The real cost is engineering time (Capacitor, weeks) and calendar time (D-U-N-S issuance, organisation verification, Apple review).

nodes.label: Google Play Organisation Account Exemption
nodes.rationale: Google's 12-tester closed-test rule is scoped to personal accounts created after 13 Nov 2023. The organisation exemption follows from that scoping but is not published as a guarantee — confirm with Play support in writing before planning a launch date around it.

nodes.label: Email-First Passcode Delivery
nodes.rationale: 375 passcodes a month costs under $0.04 by email against $99 by SMS. OTP_DELIVERY_CHANNEL=smtp is already implemented and shipping, so email-first with SMS only for members with no email costs one conditional in the sender and cuts the line by perhaps 80%.

nodes.label: Capacitor over React Native
nodes.rationale: Apple guideline 4.2 rejects repackaged websites, so a PWA wrapper alone fails review. Capacitor wraps the existing React member app and adds push, biometrics, Wallet and camera — one codebase, and the member app keeps working as a website. React Native is months plus a second codebase.

nodes.label: Wallet Pass Update Web Service Cost
nodes.rationale: The pass certificate is $0 inside the $99 membership, but a rotating QR means implementing Apple's pass update web service over APNs. Issuing a longer-lived credential instead is cheaper and weakens exactly the property the product says matters most.

nodes.label: Unpriced DPIA and Privacy Policy
nodes.rationale: Deliberately given no number because regional legal fees are not published anywhere linkable. Likely the largest single one-off line, and it gates both store submissions since both stores require a privacy policy at a public URL. Governed by Qatar's Law No. 13 of 2016, supervised by the NCSA.

nodes.label: Three-Phase Budget
nodes.rationale: Pilot ~$42/mo (one outlet, ten members, four weeks); public PWA launch ~$140-155/mo all-SMS or ~$50-75/mo email-first; both stores ~$150-165/mo recurring. Year one all in, excluding legal and engineering: roughly $1,900-3,200.

nodes.label: The Three Unsourced Figures
nodes.rationale: Azure 1-year reserved instance (~$27/mo, not on the public retail API), legal/DPIA (no published rates), and engineering time. Stated plainly so they are not mistaken for quoted prices.

nodes.label: Cost-Gated Launch Sequence
nodes.rationale: The slow items are administrative, not technical: D-U-N-S lookup, Play organisation account and the DPIA all start now because they have lead times and cost nothing. Managed Postgres, managed containers, Wallet passes and React Native are explicitly deferred.

edges.source_location: both weigh giving up the freshness window for a credential that lives outside the app (printed card, wallet pass)
